question: How does abstaining from food by day affect death from aging?
premises: Death from aging is the concern.
The practice leads to overcoming that death.
inference: By abstaining from food during the day, one will go beyond death from aging.
uncertainties: The exact sense of gamiṣyate with mṛtyuṃ may mean overcome or pass beyond.
plain_english: By abstaining from food during the day, one will overcome death from aging.
